criterion: Every lead in ASSIGNED, CONTACTED, NURTURING or QUALIFIED has exactly one active primary assignment, and every lead in READY_FOR_ASSIGNMENT for longer than its assignment SLA has an active QUEUED assignment.
Every routing decision and assignment records a rule_version_id that resolves to crm_rule_version and was effective at decision time.
measurement: count of decisions without a valid, effective rule version = 0

criterion: Every assignment with manual_override_flag has an override_reason_code and override_user_role in the allowed values.
measurement: count of overrides missing reason or role = 0

criterion: Every SLA event has started_at, target_at and sla_outcome; closed clocks have stopped_at and a stop event from the SLA's stop list; no terminal lead has an open SLA-06 or SLA-08 clock.
First-contact SLA outcome equals met when the first contact attempt occurs before target_at computed on the business calendar, and breached otherwise.
measurement: recomputed outcome = stored outcome for 100% of SLA-06 events

criterion: Every reassignment has prior_assignment_id and prior_rm_id, the prior assignment is ended with status REASSIGNED, and no historical assignment row is deleted.
measurement: count of reassignments without preserved history = 0

criterion: No assignment is created for an RM whose utilization at decision time is at or above the hard limit unless manual_override_flag and capacity_exception_flag are true.
No lead in a mandatory-specialist industry has an active primary assignment to a non-specialist RM without an approved override.
Every lead in a terminal status has a disposition_code that exists in the disposition catalog and applies to that status.
measurement: count of terminal leads with missing or mismatched disposition = 0

criterion: After a merge, the survivor holds every source touch of every merged lead, each with its original_lead_id, channel, campaign or partner code and timestamp unchanged.
measurement: source-touch count and content before merge = after merge

criterion: Leads without market context remain processable (reach routing) and carry market_evidence_flag = no_market_context; Tier 3 leads carry scale_only_limited_evidence; no routing or SLA outcome differs because of the market-opportunity score.
measurement: violations = 0 and outcome invariance check passes

criterion: language_match_flag is null for every decision whose lead has stated_service_language = not stated; no field stores an inferred language or personal characteristic.
Every lead missing a channel-required field enters VALIDATION_PENDING before any assignment.
measurement: count of leads assigned with a missing required field = 0

criterion: Exact and high-confidence matches produce MERGED leads without review; review-tier matches pass through DUPLICATE_REVIEW before MERGED or READY_FOR_ASSIGNMENT.
measurement: count of review-tier merges without a review decision = 0

criterion: Every lead has geography_status; leads with resolved_cma have a cma_code_sgc2021 in analytics.dim_cma; conflict and missing geography never reach an RM without manual review.
Every assignment not acknowledged or declined within SLA-05 has a breach event and a reassignment trigger.
measurement: count of unacknowledged breached assignments without reassignment = 0

criterion: Every activity references an assignment that was active at activity time and belongs to the same RM.
Every breached assignment or first-contact SLA has escalation_level >= 1, and escalations unresolved within SLA-10 reach level 2.
Every CH-BRN or CH-PTR source touch can be joined to its surviving lead's current status and final disposition.
No lead whose prospect has existing_relationship_flag = true has an RM acquisition assignment.
Every status-history (from_status, to_status) pair matches a transition in lead_transition_rules; audited reopenings carry reopen_approver_role.
Every QUALIFIED lead has exactly one opportunity; every CONVERTED lead's opportunity is won.
Every NURTURING lead has a next_contact_due_at and an active owner.
Every CH-RMP lead within capacity and territory is assigned to its prospecting RM.
measurement: share of eligible CH-RMP leads self-assigned = 100%

criterion: Every cma_code_sgc2021 and every (industry_system, industry_code) in CRM tables resolves to analytics.dim_cma and analytics.dim_industry.
Every CRM row has record_source = synthetic_generator; fictional emails end in .example and phone numbers use the reserved 555-01xx range; contact fields are absent from marts.
Exactly one capacity snapshot per active RM per business day; utilization recomputes from assignments and configured weights within 1e-6.
Lifecycle timestamps are non-decreasing in the defined order for every lead.
Funnel counts reconcile: received = valid + invalid + merged (+ still validating); each later stage is a subset of the previous one.
Routing and capacity KPIs recompute from assignments, decisions and snapshots.
Data-quality KPIs recompute from lead, status and assignment tables.
Two generator runs with the same seed produce byte-identical outputs.
The CRM section of the pipeline completes within 15 minutes locally.
SLA target_at recomputes from started_at using the configured business calendar and province time zone.
measurement: recomputed = stored for 100% of SLA events

criterion: No production integration, ML model or dashboard artifact exists in the repository for the CRM layer.
